name: Reachy Blocks
description: An interactive AI application on Hugging Face Spaces.

paragraphs: A Scratch-style, no-code dashboard for the Reachy Mini robot, powered by 0G decentralized compute by default. Drag blocks to make Reachy move, talk, listen, and react. Runs entirely in your browser - no install. Includes a built-in 3D simulator so you can try it without owning a robot.

Get your 0G API key at pc.0g.ai → paste it in Settings ⚙ → you're ready to chat with your robot. Or use any OpenAI-compatible provider (OpenAI / Together / Groq / self-hosted) by selecting "Other" in Settings.
A receptionist that listens, replies via AI, and waves:
features: 🧩 9 block categories - Motion (head, body, antennas, wave, sleep/wake), Sound (TTS, mic, sound files), AI (chat, system+user prompt, decide), Sensing (head pose, body yaw, antennas, is-moving), Control, Math, Text,…

🤖 Real robot or 3D sim, same blocks - when no robot is connected, your program animates a 3D Reachy Mini rendered from the official URDF + meshes. Connect a real robot, and the same blocks execute against it. Switch is…

⚡ 0G Compute by default - chat + STT (Whisper) run on 0G's decentralized network. Models include deepseek/deepseek-chat-v3-0324, qwen3.6-plus, zai-org/GLM-5-FP8, and qwen3-vl-30b-a3b-instruct. Switch to OpenAI or any…

🗣 End-to-end voice loop - Whisper STT (mic → text), chat completions, TTS routed through the robot's WebRTC audio sender so the robot's speaker is what talks. (0G doesn't expose TTS yet, so the say block uses your…
🛑 Real Stop button - cooperative cancellation cleanly aborts mic recording, AI calls, and motion mid-trajectory.
